story.iWant: to score confidence in each recommendation based on data quality and freshness
story.soThat: the user knows the reliability of each pick
story.tasks:
- Task 1: Review architecture and data contracts - Load development-stories.md Story 5.3 to understand confidence scoring requirements - Understand that confidence is separate from EV calculation (5.1) and thresholding (5.2) - Verify data model: timestamps available in Fixture and EVResult from previous stories - Confirm scoring range: [0, 100] with base of 75 - Document dependencies: Requires Story 5.1 (EVResult), Story 5.2 (picks), Story 3.3 (data quality score for reference)
- Task 2: Create ConfidenceScoreBreakdown Pydantic model - Create Pydantic model with fields: base_score, form_adjustment, injury_adjustment, odds_adjustment, sample_size_adjustment, total_adjustments, final_confidence, explanation - Add docstring with example breakdown - Add validation: final_confidence must be in [0, 100] - Add calculated field for total_adjustments (sum of all adjustments)
- Task 3: Implement base score function - Function: def calculate_base_score() -> int - Always return 75 (constant base score) - Include docstring explaining why 75% baseline
- Task 4: Implement individual scoring functions - Function: def score_form_freshness(form_timestamp: datetime | None) -> int - Function: def score_injury_freshness(injury_timestamp: datetime | None) -> int - Function: def score_odds_freshness(odds_timestamp: datetime | None) -> int - Function: def score_form_sample_size(games_count: int) -> int
- Task 5: Implement orchestrator function - Function: async def score_pick(ev_result: EVResult, fixture: Fixture) -> ConfidenceScoreBreakdown - Extract timestamps from fixture and ev_result - Call all individual scoring functions - Calculate total_adjustments and final_confidence with clamping to [0, 100]
- Task 6: Implement batch scoring function - Function: async def apply_confidence_scoring(picks: list[EVResult], fixtures: list[Fixture]) -> list[dict[str, Any]] - Validate inputs (non-empty lists) - For each pick: find corresponding fixture by fixture_id - Log scoring summary: average confidence, min/max, picks by confidence tier
- Task 7: Test timestamp handling in Fixture/EVResult - Verify Fixture model has timestamps for: form_last_updated, injuries_last_checked, odds_timestamp - Create fixture/ev_result factory for testing with different timestamp scenarios
- Task 8: Create unit tests - Create /tests/unit/test_confidence_scorer.py with 50+ test cases - Achieve > 85% code coverage on confidence_scorer module
- Task 9: Create integration test with Story 5.2 - Create /tests/integration/test_confidence_scoring_pipeline.py with 15+ test cases - Test full pipeline: picks from 5.2 → confidence scoring
- Task 10: Write module documentation - Module docstring: explain confidence scoring purpose, baseline 75%, adjustments - Document all functions: parameters, return types, examples

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Create `/src/bet_bot/analysis/edge/confidence_scorer.py` module 2. Implement `def calculate_base_score() -> int` that returns 75 (baseline confidence) 3. Implement `def score_form_freshness(form_timestamp: datetime | None) -> int` that returns: - +15 points if form < 24 hours old - +10 points if form 24-48 hours old - -5 points if form > 48 hours old - 0 points if form data missing 4. Implement `def score_injury_freshness(injury_timestamp: datetime | None) -> int` that returns: - +5 points if injuries < 12 hours old - -10 points if injuries missing or > 12 hours old 5. Implement `def score_odds_freshness(odds_timestamp: datetime | None) -> int` that returns: - +5 points if odds < 30 minutes old - -5 points if odds 30-60 minutes old - -10 points if odds > 60 minutes old 6. Implement `def score_form_sample_size(games_count: int) -> int` that returns: - 0 points if games_count >= 10 (already counted in base) - -10 points if games_count < 5 7. Implement `async def score_pick(ev_result: EVResult, fixture: Fixture) -> dict[str, int]` orchestrator function 8. Clamp final confidence to [0, 100] range (never < 0%, never > 100%) 9. Create `ConfidenceScoreBreakdown` Pydantic model to structure scoring results 10. Implement `async def apply_confidence_scoring(picks: list[EVResult], fixtures: list[Fixture]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]` batch function

internal: - src/bet_bot/models/fixtures.py::Fixture (AC #7, for timestamp extraction) - src/bet_bot/analysis/edge/ev_calculator.py::EVResult (AC #7, input model for scoring) - Story 5.1 (expected value calculation) - provides EVResult model and fixtures with ev_results - Story 5.2 (threshold filter) - produces filtered picks (recommended) as input to batch scoring - Story 3.3 (data quality scoring) - similar but separate scoring logic (for reference, not import)
frameworks: - Pydantic v2 (BaseModel, field_validator, ConfigDict)

story-context.constraints: - Base confidence score is ALWAYS 75 (AC #2): Non-configurable constant, hardcoded starting point - Final confidence clamped to [0, 100] (AC #8): Never return < 0 or > 100, use min/max clamping - Timestamps MUST be timezone-aware UTC (CLAUDE.md rule): All datetime comparisons use datetime.now(timezone.utc), per Python 3.14+ deprecation rules - Use datetime.now(timezone.utc) NOT datetime.utcnow() (deprecated in Python 3.12, removed 3.14) - All type hints use modern syntax: list[X], dict[K,V], X | None (NOT List, Dict, Optional) per CLAUDE.md Python 3.14+ rules - Pydantic v2 ONLY: Use @field_validator (NOT @validator), ConfigDict (NOT Config class), field_validator with mode="after" for post-validation - Module logger at top level: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__), use logger.debug/info/warning/error throughout - Graceful degradation on missing timestamps: Missing timestamp → penalty points, NOT exception. Continue processing (AC #4, #5). - Error handling per CLAUDE.md: Try/catch per pick in batch processing, continue on failure, log errors, never swallow exceptions silently - Timestamp data availability: Fixture model must expose form_last_updated, injuries_last_checked, odds_timestamp fields (or derivable from home_team/away_team/consolidated data) - Data dictionary constraints: Form data freshness < 24h (AC #3), Injuries < 12h (AC #4), Odds < 60min triggers rejection (AC #5) - Testing: > 85% code coverage required (AC #8), 50+ unit tests, 15+ integration tests (AC #9) - Import chain: Import EVResult from bet_bot.analysis.edge.ev_calculator, Fixture from bet_bot.models.fixtures
story-context.interfaces:
- name: score_form_freshness kind: function signature signature: def score_form_freshness(form_timestamp: datetime | None) -> int description: Calculate form data freshness points. Returns +15 (< 24h), +10 (24-48h), -5 (> 48h), 0 (None)
- name: score_injury_freshness kind: function signature signature: def score_injury_freshness(injury_timestamp: datetime | None) -> int description: Calculate injury data freshness points. Returns +5 (< 12h), -10 (None or > 12h)
- name: score_odds_freshness kind: function signature signature: def score_odds_freshness(odds_timestamp: datetime | None) -> int description: Calculate odds freshness points. Returns +5 (< 30min), -5 (30-60min), -10 (> 60min), 0 (None)
- name: score_form_sample_size kind: function signature signature: def score_form_sample_size(games_count: int) -> int description: Calculate sample size penalty. Returns 0 (>= 10 games), -10 (< 5 games)
- name: calculate_base_score kind: function signature signature: def calculate_base_score() -> int description: Return base confidence score (always 75)
- name: score_pick kind: function signature signature: async def score_pick(ev_result: EVResult, fixture: Fixture) -> ConfidenceScoreBreakdown description: Orchestrate scoring for single pick. Extract timestamps, call all scoring functions, calculate final_confidence with clamping, return ConfidenceScoreBreakdown with breakdown dict.
- name: apply_confidence_scoring kind: function signature signature: async def apply_confidence_scoring(picks: list[EVResult], fixtures: list[Fixture]) -> list[dict[str, Any]] description: Batch scoring function. For each pick find fixture, call score_pick, aggregate results with logging summary (avg confidence, min/max, tiers)
- name: ConfidenceScoreBreakdown kind: Pydantic model signature: BaseModel with fields: base_score: int, form_adjustment: int, injury_adjustment: int, odds_adjustment: int, sample_size_adjustment: int, total_adjustments: int, final_confidence: int, explanation: str description: Structured scoring result with all components and human-readable breakdown. Used as return type for score_pick() (AC #9)

tests.standards: Test framework: pytest (from pytest dependency in project) Async testing: pytest-asyncio for async def test functions Mocking: unittest.mock for Fixture/EVResult fixtures Pattern location: tests/unit/test_ev_calculator.py, tests/unit/test_threshold_filter.py show existing test patterns Structure: Organize by function (test_score_form_freshness_*, test_score_injury_freshness_*, etc.) Assertions: Use pytest assert statements with clear error messages Factories: Create Fixture and EVResult factory functions for test data generation Coverage: Target > 85% (AC #8), measure with pytest --cov=src/bet_bot/analysis/edge/confidence_scorer Edge cases: Boundary conditions (exactly 24h, 12h, 30min), None values, extreme values (0, 100, negative, 200) Fixtures: pytest fixtures for mock Fixture/EVResult objects with configurable timestamps
